title: Mountains, lanterns, and tea
description: From the snowline to the tea table: a travel journal in photographs.
story: A few favourites from travelling with my mum. Snowy peaks give way to blossom-lined paths, paper lanterns, and a stop for tea.

photos.alt: Harry in a dark coat and scarf with snow-covered mountains behind him.
photos.caption: Blue sky and snow-covered peaks.

photos.alt: A smiling selfie in front of snowy peaks, with a red hood and bright scarf in the foreground.
photos.caption: A shared moment in the snow.

photos.alt: Harry beside a mountain lake, seated on a white yak.
photos.caption: By the water, beneath the mountains.

photos.alt: Harry standing under a flowering tree on a sunny day.
photos.caption: Under the blossoms.

photos.alt: Harry standing beside illuminated paper lanterns decorated with lettering and flowers.
photos.caption: An evening among the lanterns.

photos.alt: Harry seated behind a low tea table in front of carved wooden doors.
photos.caption: At the tea table.

photos.alt: Harry in a cap and sunglasses beside a wooden lattice window and a vase of flowers.
photos.caption: A quiet corner by the window.

photos.alt: A selfie outside a tea shop, with Harry gesturing toward the counter.
photos.caption: A stop for tea.
